verdict.rationale: Milvus is a vector database, and a built-in AI assistant is a plausible capability for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The pack contains no evidence of an in-product assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The MCP server documentation lets external AI applications drive Milvus through natural language, which is an adjacent integration, not a built-in assistant, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
